ops.body: Fixed by the v0.21.0 cut: the old wire/lifeproto generator and LifecycleWire.swift are gone; internal/wiregen now generates internal/wire/frame.go and the marked section of SessionTransport.swift, and the Swift emitter produces only protocol/frame-kind/flags documentation with no repeated capability-truth claim across the two outputs. Corroborated by the gate: internal/wiregen/main.go and both generated files exist as cited.
